videos.title: All Killer: 00s Emo Anthems!
videos.description: "An hour of the greatest emo tracks the noughties had to offer featuring Linkin Park, Fall Out Boy.

videos.title: Rock Monsters! 2010-2019
videos.description: A definitive selection of rock and indie anthems from the 2010s! Starting with My Chemical Romance in 2010 right through to Liam Gallagher at the end of the decade.

videos.title: 30 Rock & Indie Heroes of the 20s
videos.description: Claire Sturgess has the finest from the 20s! From lockdown to a full-blown guitar revolution! Expect legends like Sum 41 & Green Day plus new names like Sam Fender & Yungblud.

videos.title: The New Legends Of Rock
videos.description: Rock Riffs, indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2010 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy & loads more.

videos.title: 99 Reasons The 00s Rocked!
videos.description: 99 anthems of rock from the noughties! With Green Day, Linkin Park, The Strokes, Paramore, Blink-182, The Killers & much more.

videos.title: Rated Rock! The No.1s
videos.description: Number 1 rock songs from the last 50 years! With mega hits from the Arctic Monkeys & KOL right back to legends like The Stones & T.Rex.

videos.title: Rick Wakeman's WILD Things!
videos.description: Remember when rock was WILD? From '64 to '74 the pioneering heroes presented by a man who was at the centre of it all - from The Kinks to The Beatles to Black Sabbath to Queen.

videos.title: Don't Stop! 30 Feelgood Rock Hits
videos.description: From Peter Frampton and Free to Foreigner & Fleetwood Mac - the 70s was a feelgood and carefree time for pop and rock, and we bring back that vibe with 30 of the absolute best.

videos.title: Party Rock Anthems!
videos.description: Party pop rock anthems spanning 5 decades! From Queen, Kiss & Aerosmith to Blur, Paramore & The White Stripes.

videos.title: Sunday Rock Classics
videos.description: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more.

videos.title: Queen: Rock Icons
videos.description: Starting back in 1974 here is an hour of Anthems from the greatest British rock band in the world.

videos.title: Sunday Rock Classics
videos.description: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more.

videos.title: 30 Biggest Rock Anthems!
videos.description: 30 of the biggest, timeless anthems! Featuring legendary acts like Aerosmith, Kiss, and Queen, through to Razorlight, Fall Out Boy and Evanescence.

videos.title: Sunday Rock Classics
videos.description: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more.

videos.title: Carol Decker's Leather & Lace!
videos.description: 25 years of classic rock from an era where the look was nearly as important as the music! From Led Zeppelin in 1970 to Def Leppard in 1995.

videos.title: Blazing Rock Ballads!
videos.description: The Biggest Ballads from the royals of rock! From Queen, Bon Jovi & Whitesnake to Meat Loaf, Nickleback & Evanescence.

videos.title: Big Hair & Power Chords!
videos.description: 20 epic songs loaded with mega hair energy & power chords! From 80s rock icons Boston, Whitesnake & Chicago to modern day heroes The Darkness, Green Day & My Chemical Romance.

videos.title: The Wild Ones with Suzi Quatro!
videos.description: Our godmother of Rock, Suzi Quatro is here with the wildest Rock Stars of the 70's! But who is the craziest and most outlandish? Bowie, Meat Loaf, Queen or even Suzi herself.

videos.title: Loud & Legendary: The 20 Greatest!
videos.description: The most iconic & ear-shattering rock songs that shaped the genre! Including Led Zeppelin's timeless Whole Lotta Love & AC/DC's rebellious Highway to Hell. Crank it up & enjoy.

videos.title: Sunday Rock Classics
videos.description: Rounding off the week with rock classics and anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more.

videos.title: Nicky Horne's 25 Rock Rebels!
videos.description: Rock & Roll started as a rebellion and Nicky Horne brings you the 25 people who pushed all the boundaries & refused to conform! These are the greatest Rock Rebels of all time.

videos.title: AC/DC: Rock Icons
videos.description: An hour of Anthems and the biggest rock songs from rock legends ACDC.

videos.title: Heavy Metal Madness! Top 25
videos.description: Time to brutally assault your ears with the heaviest in metal music from the monsters of 80s rock! Expect to headbang along to WASP, Anthrax, Metallica and, of course, Iron Maiden.

videos.title: Legendary Rock: 1980-1989
videos.description: These are the legendary rock stars that made the 80s! Expect Meat Loaf, Bonnie Tyler, Queen, Bon Jovi, AC/DC, Iron Maiden & loads more.

videos.title: The Glam Years!
videos.description: 1970-79, Glam, Glitter & a big slice of classic rock! From flamboyant trailblazers to stadium anthems including Bowie, Alice Cooper, T.Rex, Slade, Queen, Suzi Quatro & loads more.

videos.title: David Bowie: Rock Icon
videos.description: Starting back in 1972, An hour of Anthems and the biggest rock songs from the king of glam rock David Bowie.

videos.title: Greatest Classic Rock Bands- Ever!
videos.description: 30 years & 4 hours of classic rock bands, in order from 1965-1995! Expect to see The Stones, The Who, Joan Jett, Aerosmith, AC/DC, Queen, Genesis & The Beatles.

videos.title: Carol Decker's 1st Ladies of Rock!
videos.description: T'Pau's Carol Decker with 30 years of the most amazing women who ROCK! From Grace Slick in the 60s to Florence Welch in the 00s - these ladies all left an incredible mark.

videos.title: The Anthems!
videos.description: Turn it up to 11 for the finest rock anthems! Featuring Kings Of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro & The Foo Fighters. This is Now Rock.

videos.title: 30 Years of Rock No.1s: 1985-2015
videos.description: In order - 30 years, every song a number 1 rock single or from a classic number 1 rock album.

videos.title: The New Legends Of Rock
videos.description: Rock Riffs, indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2010 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy & loads more.

videos.title: Evanescence: Fan Favourites
videos.description: From 2003 to 2026 - 40 minutes of the biggest rock songs from Evanescence.

videos.title: Killer Cuts Of The 00s!
videos.description: A decade of mega hits and the loudest anthems! Expect Biffy Clyro, Linkin Park, Blink 182, Evanescence, Fall Out Boy & loads more.

videos.title: 30 Rock & Indie Heroes of the 20s
videos.description: Claire Sturgess has the finest from the 20s! From lockdown to a full-blown guitar revolution! Expect legends like Sum 41 & Green Day plus new names like Sam Fender & Yungblud.

videos.title: The New Legends Of Rock
videos.description: Rock Riffs, indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2010 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy & loads more.
